name: row-actions-menu
title: Row actions menu
description: The three-dot menu at the end of a row: named for its row, grouped actions, disabled items that say why, and a destructive item that asks first.
docs: label names the row ('Invoice 1042'), so the trigger reads 'Actions for Invoice 1042'. actions is a list of { id, label, icon, shortcut, group, destructive, disabled, disabledReason }; groups are divided by rules in the order they first appear. A destructive action opens a confirm popover next to the button and calls onAction only after the confirm. contextMenu also opens the menu on a right-click anywhere on the row and on Shift+F10; the row is the closest tr, [role=row] or li, and a link or a field keeps the browser's own menu. Shortcuts are display only. After a confirmed delete the row, and the focus that was on its button, are gone: move focus to the actions button of the next row yourself (the one above when it was the last, a restore link or the table when none are left). The demo does it with a layout effect keyed on the rows.
